award_lead: The court pins these small medals to the record:
intro: The Poet presides, and reads the folder like a diary: {count} entries, each one a moment somebody meant to keep.
name: The Poet

sentences.Felony-Level Archivist: Sentence: keep gathering. Every archive begins as a pile of small rememberings.
sentences.Habitual Hoarder: Sentence: wander the stacks sometimes. Old screenshots are letters from earlier selves.
sentences.Innocent Bystander: Sentence: case dismissed. Your folder is a short poem, and it scans beautifully.
sentences.Petty Offender: Sentence: a light fine of one deletion, paid only if the mood arrives.
sentences.Repeat Offender: Sentence: once a month, open the oldest screenshot and remember why it mattered.
sentences.Unrepentant Screenshot Felon: Sentence: none. A library this large is not a crime; it is an autobiography.
